rationale.lidar: 0.01 m is the lower end of the proposed 1-2 cm SIL stress range and equals one fifth of the 0.05 m map cell.
rationale.imu: 0.01 rad/s gyro and 0.1 m/s^2 acceleration are fixed zero-mean SIL perturbations, not claims about a physical IMU.
rationale.slip: mu=0.8 is a fixed 20% reduction from the explicit nominal/default mu=1.0, used only as a controlled traction stress case.
rationale.scope: Simulation-only sensitivity profile. Existing G4 goal, clearance, speed, and stop limits are unchanged.
